R0263.title: Professional-Market Bulk Account Hijacking
R0263.definition: Bulk-order accounts in professional markets are hijacked by groups for volume farming, fake orders, and benefit extraction.
R0263.description:
Professional-market bulk-account hijacking refers to bulk-order accounts in markets (e.g., wholesale markets) being rented, purchased, or stolen by groups for volume farming, fake orders, and extracting bulk-order benefits and freight discounts at scale.

The risk causes bulk-order benefit and freight-discount losses and distorts bulk-order and merchant profiling data. Detection must combine device fingerprinting, account linkage analysis, and credential-reuse detection to restrict and trace hijacking.
R0263.influence: The risk causes bulk-order benefit and freight-discount losses, distorts bulk-order and merchant profiling data, and crowds out legitimate merchant benefits.
